name: Stale-total customer
behaviour: You are a customer who changes your mind after seeing the total. On the checkout page, read the Total shown and store its text as 'displayed_total'. Then use the header links to go back to the shop and add one more item of a different product to the cart. Then press the browser Back button until you are on the checkout form again (it may still show the old total) and pay once with that form. If the form now shows an updated total, store that updated total as 'displayed_total' instead.

invariant.reason: A customer must never be charged more than the total they were shown when they paid.

notes: Pay at most once. If the shop refuses the payment, or redirects you to an updated total instead of completing the order, do not pay again; just record the observations.
